batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit, academic session 2017-2018, Set-6 — transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.260-267 (printed pp.75-82 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); no question carries both forms in this paper, so no tag-vs-solution disagreement can arise. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. Q1/Q2 INVESTIGATION: the header page (book PDF p.260) opens the 'Short Syllabus' run at Q03, and printed Q01 and Q02 are NOT on that page — but a full search of the whole span found them: Q01 and Q02 ARE printed, out of order, in the 'Extra Syllabus' block that begins at the foot of book PDF p.266 (printed p.81). No question was fabricated. The paper is printed in two syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (heading on book PDF p.260) carries 63 questions and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.266, continuing on p.267) carries the remaining 16 (Q1, 2, 5, 9, 11, 15, 17, 23, 26, 31, 35, 39, 61, 64, 68, 73). MISSING NUMBER: printed Q80 does not appear anywhere in book PDF pp.260-267 — every page of the span was searched, including the end of the Extra Syllabus block on p.267, whose last item is Q73; the pack therefore contains exactly the 79 questions that ARE printed (printed numbers 1-79, each exactly once across the two tiers) and is NOT padded to the header's 80. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Higher Mathematics Q1-40, English Q41-55, Bangla Q56-60, Physics Q61-79 (Q80 would have completed the Physics block at 20 but is not printed) — counts Higher Mathematics 40, English 15, Bangla 5, Physics 19, total 79. Page map (book PDF): p.260 → Q3, 4, 6, 7, 8 · p.261 → Q10, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19, 20 · p.262 → Q21, 22, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29 · p.263 → Q30, 32, 33, 34, 36, 37, 38, 40 · p.264 → Q41-53 · p.265 → Q54-60, 62, 63, 65, 66, 67, 69, 70 · p.266 → Q71, 72, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79 and (Extra Syllabus) Q1, 2, 5, 9 · p.267 → (Extra Syllabus) Q11, 15, 17, 23, 26, 31, 35, 39, 61, 64, 68, 73. Keys: 73 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 0 keyless, and exactly SIX printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q7, Q17, Q23, Q25, Q40 and Q78, each headed 'সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'; those six carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (the printed solution's no-answer statement), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Preserved print anomalies: Q2's options print the range with round brackets although the book's own note under the question prescribes a second bracket for sets; Q9's stem defines f(x) in terms of θ; Q26's solution heading prints 'সমাধান :' with a space before the colon; Q36's printed solution keys (d) but then shows the stem's premise (roots 4 and -4) is wrong; Q38's solution computes the distance as 'CB' although the stem asks from the origin; Q47(b) prints 'then' for 'than'; Q48(b) prints 'suggesstion', Q48(c) 'hipopotamus' and Q48(d) 'vulger'; Q50's stem word 'Water' is underlined in print; Q64(b) and Q64(d) print positive exponents (8 × 10^6 Wb, 4 × 10^6 Wb); Q75(a) prints its unit as 'ft' (490 ft) against the metres of the other options; Q76's printed solution computes the acceleration as -16 ms^-2 (the value at option (b)) but keys (a) 16 ms^-2 as the মন্দন (deceleration) — the printed key (a) is recorded and the tension flagged in that question's extractionNote. No question in this paper carries a figure of its own; diagrams appear only inside the printed worked solutions of Q4, Q18 and Q28. BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF p.259 belongs to the PREVIOUS paper (JU H Unit 2018-2019 Set-A) and book PDF p.268 opens the NEXT paper (JU H Unit 2016-2017 Set-1); nothing outside pp.260-267 is included in this pack. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান: ২০১৭-১৮') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-6 of JU H Unit 2017-2018 occupies printed pp.75-82 = book PDF pp.260-267: the 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.260-266 (heading on p.260) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning at the foot of printed p.81 (book PDF p.266) and continuing on printed p.82 (book PDF p.267). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.260) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-২০১৮ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-6, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. Printed Q1 and Q2 are not on the header page (the Short Syllabus run opens at Q03) but are printed in the Extra Syllabus block on book PDF p.266; printed Q80 appears nowhere in pp.260-267, so this pack holds the 79 printed questions only. The previous paper (H 2018-2019 Set-A) ends on book PDF p.259 and the following paper (H 2016-2017 Set-1) begins on book PDF p.268. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image (300-dpi renders), with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at ~200%) for Q2, Q10, Q15, Q17, Q24, Q25, Q28, Q37, Q39, Q47-Q48, Q56-Q65 and Q64. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →).
